summary: Alpha Compute Corp, a BVI-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under ALP, furnished a Form 6-K reporting a binding offtake contract signed September 30, 2026 for its ALPHA-02 cluster, a high-density NVIDIA B300 GPU deployment in a 100% hydropowered Swedish data center. Total contract value is $71.9 million, expected to add roughly $24 million in annual contracted revenue, lifting projected annual revenue to about $47 million. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, ownership change, or structural/regulatory mechanic is disclosed; this is an ordinary commercial contract announcement, not a special situation. Watch execution and counterparty concentration risk.
